#### Notes:

The observations for the NASDAQ Composite Index represent the daily index value at market close. The market typically closes at 4 PM ET, except for holidays when it sometimes closes early.

The NASDAQ Composite Index is a market capitalization weighted index with more than 3000 common equities listed on the NASDAQ Stock Market. The types of securities in the index include American depositary receipts (ADRs), common stocks, real estate investment trusts (REITs), and tracking stocks. The index includes all NASDAQ listed stocks that are not derivatives, preferred shares, funds, exchange-traded funds (ETFs) or debentures.

## **Financial Products News \#2026 - 39**    Nasdaq to Terminate Indexes Effective After the Close of Business on Tuesday, August 18, 2026

| ### Markets Impacted:<br>- All Markets<br>### Data Feeds Impacted:<br>- Nasdaq Global Index Data Service [(GIDS 2.0)](http://www.nasdaqtrader.com/Trader.aspx?id=globalindexDS)<br>- Nasdaq Global Index Watch [(GIW)](https://indexes.nasdaq.com/)<br>- Nasdaq Global Index FlexFile Delivery [(GIFFD)](https://indexes.nasdaqomx.com/Home/FlexFileDelivery)<br>### Contact Information:<br>- [Index Services](mailto:indexservices@nasdaq.com) | ### What you need to know:<br>Effective after the close of business on **Tuesday, August 18, 2026**, Nasdaq will cease the calculation and dissemination of the following indexes:<br>- Nasdaq Global Income Leaders Index (Symbol: NQGILI)<br>- Nasdaq Global Income Leaders TR Index (Symbol: NQGILIT)<br>- Nasdaq Global Income Leaders NTR Index (Symbol: NQGILIN)<br>- Nasdaq Global Income Leaders AUD Index (Symbol: NQGILIAUD)<br>- Nasdaq Global Income Leaders AUD TR Index (Symbol: NQGILIAUDT)<br>- Nasdaq Global Income Leaders AUD NTR Index (Symbol: NQGILIAUDN) |

* * *

### How will this impact data feeds?

Nasdaq will cease the calculation and dissemination of index values and directory messages for the above indexes on the following Nasdaq proprietary index data services:

- Nasdaq Global Index Data Service [(GIDS)](http://www.nasdaqtrader.com/Trader.aspx?id=globalindexDS)
- Nasdaq Global Index Watch [(GIW)](https://indexes.nasdaq.com/)
- Nasdaq Global Index FlexFile Delivery [(GIFFD)](https://indexes.nasdaqomx.com/Home/FlexFileDelivery/)

### Where can I find additional information?

For questions about Nasdaq index products, please contact [Index Services](mailto:indexservices@nasdaq.com) or visit [GIW](https://indexes.nasdaq.com/).
